recovered_memory.title: Origin resolution is conjunctive, not similarity-based
recovered_memory.summary: A candidate source may resolve M-004, M-005, or M-006 only when one immutable object simultaneously passes explicit assignment, namespace, owner, semantic-role, temporal-precedence, and locator-integrity checks. Exact label reuse, textual similarity, discovery order, or a later report boundary cannot substitute for any missing condition.

gates.pass_when: The candidate performs an assignment of the identifier to a referent, rather than merely mentioning or reporting the identifier.
The identifier belongs to the same continuity namespace as the unresolved queue node.
The candidate's owning system or team agrees with the continuity artifact owner or has an explicit provenance handoff.
The assigned referent has the same artifact type and functional role as the unresolved identifier claim.
The assignment is at or before the repository report boundary, or carries a verifiable immutable back-reference to an older qualifying assignment.
The source can be re-fetched by an immutable locator and its retained digest matches the evaluated content.

decision_rule.accept_when: All six gates pass for the same candidate object and referent.

claims.text: The active queue requires immutable provenance and the originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, or chat-history source; prior continuity artifacts separately reject temporal and namespace collisions.
Because each existing gate excludes a different false-positive class, origin promotion must be conjunctive rather than score-based.
All future candidate-origin evidence packets should emit one result per gate and a final fail-closed disposition using this contract.
A strong semantic match or exact identifier match may compensate for missing provenance dimensions.
No candidate for M-004, M-005, or M-006 has yet been demonstrated to pass all six gates under exhaustive source coverage.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_conflict: A candidate can be highly similar, temporally eligible, and immutably stored while still lacking explicit assignment or namespace agreement.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: Eligibility is not identity. The candidate remains a lead until every required dimension converges on the same object and referent.

falsification_route: Produce one immutable candidate object for an unresolved identifier.
Re-fetch it by immutable locator and verify its digest.
Demonstrate explicit assignment, matching namespace, owner, semantic role, and temporal eligibility.
If any gate fails or cannot be evaluated, retain unresolved status.
next_resolution_step: Build a no-overwrite candidate evidence packet for each discovered pre-boundary source, evaluate all six gates, and promote no origin until exhaustive branch coverage and eligible privacy-reviewed source coverage are documented.
